vars.report: a tower can be planted so that no way is left to the seed store, neither for the pests still to come nor for those already on the field: the pests then stand still and the wave never ends

vars.subject: Battle class (scripts/Battle.cs: building, sap, seeds, and which pest a tower shoots)
vars.rules: a tower costs its price in sap and one that costs more than the sap left cannot be placed, a pest that falls pays its reward, a pest that reaches the store takes its own number of seeds (a beetle takes 2), the map is lost when the last seed goes, a tower shoots only pests within its range, and of those it shoots the one closest to the store along its way

mutants.name: a tower dearer than the sap left can be placed
the map goes on with no seed left
towers shoot the newest pest in range

vars.feature: selling a tower: a new Battle.Sell(cell) that removes the tower on that cell and returns the sap it gives back, which is added to the sap: 70% of everything paid for the tower (its cost and every upgrade bought for it), rounded down. The cell is open again, the route and every pest on the field take the way it opens, and on a cell without a tower, or once the map is over, it does nothing and returns 0
